extraction.eligibility_summary: NPTEL course toppers and candidates passing the certification exam in the Elite-Gold category are only eligible to apply. The internships will be considered for the Students and Faculty members (as per the profession selected during the course enrolment). The students will be considered for the in-person internships only. Faculty members who cannot avail leave from their workplace and the candidates with disabilities (PwD) will only be considered for the virtual internship, wherever feasible.

evidence.source_location: IIT Guwahati's BSc (Hons.) in Data Science and AI program (SOURCE TEXT: The BSc (Hons.) in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence offered by IIT Guwahati is a forward-looking undergraduate program designed to build strong foundations in data science, AI, and computational thinking.
